$comment: Machine-readable canvas/workbench feature inventory. Source of truth for scripts/canvas-coverage-report.ts. A feature with an empty proof_tests array is UNCOVERED and fails the gate.

features.name: HTML/live prototype preview canvas (HtmlViewer)
features.user_action: Open an HTML/prototype file in the workspace
features.expected_result: Iframe renders the artifact via direct URL load or srcDoc inline (chosen by file-viewer-render-mode.ts); auto-detects and works around focus-stealing, redirect loops, sandbox-storage needs, and GPU/WASM-heavy content via a cross-origin-isolated preview path

features.name: URL-load vs srcDoc iframe render-mode decision engine
features.user_action: N/A — automatic per file based on which bridges are active (comment/inspect/edit/palette/tweaks/deck/draw)
features.expected_result: shouldUrlLoadHtmlPreview() forces srcDoc whenever any interactive bridge, root-relative project asset refs, focus-stealing, or self-redirect patterns are detected; otherwise defaults to faster per-asset URL loading. Every exported function (hasTweaksTemplate, shouldUrlLoadHtmlPreview, hasUrlModeBridge, parseForceInline, htmlNeedsFocusGuard, htmlNeedsPoweredPreview, htmlNeedsSandboxShim, htmlNeedsRedirectGuard) is pure and directly unit-testable per its own docblock, and this contract is load-bearing enough that AGENTS.md documents it explicitly

features.name: Deploy to Vercel or Cloudflare Pages
features.user_action: Open the Share menu, pick a provider, enter token/account settings, click deploy
features.expected_result: Opens a deploy modal per provider (Vercel default; Cloudflare Pages with account id + zone selection), deploys to preview or production, tracks deploy result, allows re-deploy

features.name: Comment / Board mode — inspect + pod (lasso) element selection
features.user_action: Click the comment toolbar icon to enter board mode; hover/click an element (inspect) or lasso-drag across multiple elements to group them into a 'pod'; type a note
features.expected_result: A live selection overlay highlights the hovered/selected DOM target or grouped pod (weighted opacity by area); a composer anchored to the selection lets the note send immediately as a chat attachment or save as a persistent, repliable comment thread with open/resolved status

features.name: Draw / Mark annotation overlay (box, pen, text) with screenshot capture and upload
features.user_action: Click the mark-pen toolbar icon; draw a box, freehand stroke, or drop a draggable text label over the live preview; undo/redo; Send/Queue/Add-to-input
features.expected_result: PreviewDrawOverlay renders a canvas layer over the preview, normalizing marks to frame coordinates (0..1) so they track zoom/viewport; on submit, a client-composited screenshot uploads through the standard project-upload path and a structured comment attachment (screenshotPath + bounds + target selector) is staged and dispatched to chat/agent; strokes/boxes/text each have Cmd+Z / Cmd+Shift+Z undo/redo; if screenshot capture itself fails, the structured position/selector fields still ride along

features.name: Manual Edit Mode — click-to-select element, inline text edit
features.user_action: Toggle the Edit tool in the artifact toolbar; click any tagged element in the preview; type directly (contenteditable) for text/link elements
features.expected_result: Element discovery/click-to-select/inline-text-edit runs via an injected iframe bridge; typed text commits on blur/Enter, is applied to the HTML source string, persisted to the server as a new 'manual' file version, and the preview re-renders

features.name: Manual Edit Mode — undo/redo across saves
features.user_action: Trigger undo/redo from the edit panel or keyboard while in Manual Edit mode
features.expected_result: Each undo/redo re-persists the before/after source as a new server-tracked version (not an ephemeral in-memory stack) and the preview reflects the reverted/reapplied state; a stale local history is detected and cleared if the file changed out-of-band

features.name: Manual edit source-patch engine (applyManualEditPatch)
features.user_action: N/A — invoked by every Manual Edit Mode action (text/link/image/outer-html/delete/page-style edits)
features.expected_result: A pure HTML-string patcher handles set-text/set-link/set-image/set-style/set-attributes/set-outer-html/remove-element/set-token against the raw source, independent of any DOM/iframe; every manual-edit UI feature depends on this function being correct, so a defect here corrupts saved source across all of them

features.name: Storyboard — shot CRUD, frame generation, video render, take review
features.user_action: Add/duplicate/delete/reorder shots; generate or iterate a start/end frame; upload an image; render a shot to video; compare multiple 'takes' and approve/reject/select one
features.expected_result: Each mutation applies optimistically then PATCHes /api/storyboards/:id with a single 409-conflict retry; renders poll a long-running media task; the selected take marks the shot 'done' for assembly

features.name: Figma import — offline .fig file decode
features.user_action: '+' → Import from Figma → Upload .fig tab → drop or browse a .fig file exported from Figma, optionally add build notes
features.expected_result: Decoded entirely on-device (no Figma account) via POST /api/projects/:id/figma/import; returns node/page/frame/component counts, colors, fonts, and a 'Build' action that seeds the chat prompt; oversized (>200MB) or non-.fig files rejected client-side; decode failures surface FIGMA_IMPORT_FAILED with the caught error message; a per-asset 12MB cap inside the decoded snapshot guards against oversized embedded assets

features.name: OD Library clipper ingest (browser extension)
features.user_action: Via the paired OD 'clipper' Chrome extension, browse any live webpage and capture an element/screenshot/HTML
features.expected_result: POSTs to /api/library/ingest with sourceKind='clipper', authenticated by a pairing token (allowlisted origin), capped at 5,000,000 total bytes/request regardless of the manual-upload MIME policy; captures land in the Library grid and refresh live via SSE (/api/library/events)

features.name: Connectors catalog (MCP tool integrations) — connect/disconnect
features.user_action: Open Connectors, type in search, click Connect on a card
features.expected_result: Grid is masked/disabled until a Composio key is configured; search ranks by name/provider match; Connect opens an OAuth popup or system-browser flow and polls status until connected

features.name: Chat/Workspace resizable split
features.user_action: Drag the vertical divider between chat and the file workspace, or Tab-focus it and use arrow keys
features.expected_result: Chat panel width adjusts live, clamped between a computed min/max relative to split width; final width persists to localStorage and survives reload

features.name: Workspace focus mode (hide chat)
features.user_action: Click the focus-expand chevron in the workspace tab bar
features.expected_result: Chat pane is hidden (hidden={workspaceFocused}); FileWorkspace occupies full width; a chevron button restores split view

features.name: Manual-edit fixed left inspector layout
features.user_action: Enter Edit mode on an HTML preview
features.expected_result: Split layout switches from a draggable resize handle to a fixed 'split-edit-divider'; the chat slot region hosts a comment-left-host or edit inspector instead of ChatPane

features.name: Tabbed workspace — tab bar, Pages dropdown, dynamic tabs, drag reorder
features.user_action: Click a workspace tab, open the Pages dropdown, or open a file/terminal/side-chat/browser tab via the '+' launcher; drag a tab to reorder; wheel-scroll the tab strip
features.expected_result: One persistent tab per open file/terminal/side-chat/browser/live-artifact; tabs are draggable with a drop-edge indicator, horizontally wheel-scrollable, and closeable

features.name: Design Files panel — file tree/grid, upload, rename, delete, download project
features.user_action: Open the Design Files tab; drag-drop or click Upload; right-click or use row actions to rename/delete; click Download Project
features.expected_result: Files render as a list/grid rooted at rootDirName; upload shows progress/error banner; delete supports single and multi-select; Download Project produces a zip archive

features.name: Embedded in-app Browser tab
features.user_action: Click 'New Browser' from the tab launcher or Design Files panel
features.expected_result: A DesignBrowserPanel tab opens with URL navigation, page snapshot toast, and the ability to attach the browsed page as a comment/board attachment

features.name: In-app Terminal tab
features.user_action: Open 'New Terminal' from the tab launcher
features.expected_result: A TerminalViewer tab opens bound to a persisted terminal session id; multiple terminals are numbered

features.name: Side-chat tab
features.user_action: Open a side chat from the tab launcher
features.expected_result: A secondary ChatPane-style conversation opens as its own workspace tab, independent of the main chat

features.name: Sketch (Excalidraw) editor for .sketch.json files
features.user_action: Click 'New Sketch' in Design Files, or open an existing .sketch.json file; draw shapes/text/images/frames; Save or Export image
features.expected_result: Lazy-loaded Excalidraw canvas with save/clear/export-image actions; dirty state tracked and autosaved; exported PNG saved as a sibling file; save-state indicator shows saving/dirty/saved

features.name: Design System project panel
features.user_action: Click the Design System tab (present when the project is a design-system project)
features.expected_result: Shows generation progress, section review cards (colors, typography, spacing/radius, guidance, preview, UI kit, assets), 'needs work' feedback, and use/duplicate/delete actions

features.name: Page Creator dialog (new page from template/preset)
features.user_action: Click '+' in the Pages menu to open the Page Creator
features.expected_result: Category-filtered gallery of blank/preset page templates (prototype, deck, wireframe, mobile, image, video, audio, live-artifact, document/markdown, hyperframes) with live thumbnail previews; selecting one creates and opens a new page file

features.name: Zoom control (manual levels + desktop auto-fit)
features.user_action: Click the zoom percentage in the toolbar; pick 50/75/100/125/150/200% or leave it in auto mode
features.expected_result: Preview scales via CSS transform; in 'auto' mode + desktop viewport, zoom auto-fits content width via desktopPreviewAutoFitZoomPercent(); manual selection pins zoomMode to 'manual'

features.name: Device viewport switcher (Desktop / Tablet / Mobile)
features.user_action: Click the viewport icon/dropdown in the toolbar or the 'more' overflow menu
features.expected_result: Preview frame resizes to fixed 820x1180 (tablet) or 390x844 (mobile) with auto-fit scaling within canvas padding, or fluid full-width (desktop); choice is cached per project+file

features.name: Source / Preview mode toggle
features.user_action: Click the code icon in the toolbar
features.expected_result: Switches the pane between rendered iframe preview and raw source code view

features.name: Screenshot copy
features.user_action: Click the screenshot icon while in preview mode
features.expected_result: Captures the current preview frame and copies it to clipboard as an image

features.name: Comment side panel / side dock (list, thread, drag-reorder, board batch send)
features.user_action: Click the comment-count toolbar icon to open the side panel; drag comment cards to reorder; attach images to a batch and send
features.expected_result: Docked or stacked (responsive) side panel lists all preview comments with reorder-by-drag, collapse/expand, image previews, and a 'send board batch' action that queues/sends attached comments+images to chat

features.name: Inspect panel — quick live CSS tuning on one element
features.user_action: Toggle Inspect, click an element, drag color/font-size/weight/align/padding/radius controls
features.expected_result: Style changes preview live in the iframe via a srcDoc bridge; 'Save to source' persists as an injected style block; 'Reset element' reverts to the pre-edit outerHTML snapshot

features.name: Manual Edit — style/content inspector panel
features.user_action: With an element selected in Edit mode, adjust typography/color/spacing/layout fields or link href/image src/alt in the right-docked panel, then Save
features.expected_result: A set-style / set-text / set-link / set-image patch applies and persists; live preview streams style changes via postMessage before the explicit Save commits a version

features.name: Manual Edit — inline raw HTML editing for a container
features.user_action: Select a container element with nested markup; edit its outer HTML directly in the CONTENT textarea and Save
features.expected_result: set-outer-html patch replaces the element's outerHTML (must remain exactly one root element) and persists as a version

features.name: Manual Edit — delete element / upload image / page-level styles
features.user_action: Click the trash icon on a selected element, upload a new image for an image element, or click empty canvas to open page-level background/font/size controls
features.expected_result: remove-element / set-image / body-level set-style patches apply and persist; deleting the last renderable body child is blocked with an error

features.name: Tweaks bridge (class-based theme/motion toggle template)
features.user_action: Toggle the Tweaks palette on an artifact that ships the .tw-panel/.tw-hidden template
features.expected_result: A srcDoc-injected bridge emits od:tweaks-available on mount and drives panel visibility; forces srcDoc render mode (never available on URL-load path); also carries the design-templates/tweaks --motion Off/Subtle/Lively multiplier (the one licensed GSAP-adjacent visual-motion surface permitted per docs/decisions/gsap-licensing.md)

features.name: Present mode (in-tab, fullscreen, new tab)
features.user_action: Click the Present (slideshow) icon, choose 'In this tab', 'Fullscreen', or 'Open in new tab'
features.expected_result: Preview enters a chrome-less presentation state; fullscreen shows an Esc-to-exit hint; deck files get slide-navigation controls in presentation mode

features.name: Deck / slide presentation controls
features.user_action: Use Prev/Next slide buttons, keyboard arrows/PageUp/PageDown/Home/End/R, or click a slide thumbnail
features.expected_result: Slide index advances/resets via a postMessage bridge to the deck runtime; a collapsible thumbnail rail shows all slides; counter displays 'current / total'

features.name: Speaker notes (view + inline edit)
features.user_action: Click into the speaker notes panel while on a deck; edit text; blur to save
features.expected_result: Per-slide speaker notes editor with save-state feedback; placeholder shown when empty

features.name: File version history — browse, preview, restore
features.user_action: Open version history from the toolbar/more-menu; scroll/search the list; click a version to preview; click Restore
features.expected_result: Each version (ai/manual/restore-sourced) previews in an isolated iframe with its generating prompt shown; Restore reverts the live file to that content and records a new 'restore' version

features.name: Export: PDF, PPTX (editable or screenshot), image (PNG/JPEG/WebP)
features.user_action: Open the Download menu and pick an export format
features.expected_result: Triggers the corresponding export pipeline; PPTX offers 'editable' vs 'screenshot' modes and is disabled while streaming; image export offers a PNG/JPEG/WebP picker

features.name: Share link / share page
features.user_action: Open the Share menu and click 'Copy share link' or 'Open share page'
features.expected_result: Copies or opens a public share URL for the deployed artifact; disabled with a guiding hint when nothing is deployed yet or the run is still streaming

features.name: Social share flow
features.user_action: Click 'Share to social' in the Share menu
features.expected_result: Deploys (if needed) and produces a shareable social post/link

features.name: Save as reusable Template
features.user_action: Use the template-save action to name and describe a project template
features.expected_result: Persists the current artifact as a user template surfaced later in the New Project 'Template' tab

features.name: React component viewer
features.user_action: Open a .jsx/.tsx component file
features.expected_result: ReactComponentViewer renders the compiled component in an isolated preview alongside module-pointer diagnostics

features.name: Live Artifact viewer (connector-backed / data-bearing)
features.user_action: Open a Live Artifact tab
features.expected_result: Tabs across Preview / Code / metadata / provenance / refresh history; supports manual refresh with event/status timeline and error surfacing

features.name: Image / Video / Audio / SVG / Binary viewers
features.user_action: Open a file of that media type
features.expected_result: Dedicated lightweight viewer per type (native img/video/audio, SVG source/preview toggle, generic binary fallback with metadata)

features.name: Markdown viewer (split/preview modes, code-block copy, image rewriting, inline edit/save)
features.user_action: Open a .md file; toggle split vs. preview; edit and save
features.expected_result: Renders GFM with syntax-highlighted, copy-button-equipped code blocks; rewrites relative image sources against the project file root; tracks save state and scroll-ratio sync between edit/preview panes in split mode

features.name: JSON / plain-text viewer
features.user_action: Open a .json or text file
features.expected_result: Formats JSON preserving precision-sensitive numbers (avoids silent float rounding); plain text viewer shows line numbers and copy

features.name: Critique Theater / Design Jury (read-only, non-editing)
features.user_action: Watch a live multi-panelist critique stream during a run; optionally click Interrupt
features.expected_result: Read-only phase-driven UI (live -> shipped/degraded/interrupted/failed); Interrupt POSTs a kill request and optimistically flips to interrupted. Confirmed out of scope for edit-hardening — included only so the exclusion is explicit

features.name: Design Systems catalog browse (Mine / Official / Enterprise)
features.user_action: Open Design Systems, switch scope tab, pick a category chip or surface pill, type in search
features.expected_result: Grid/list narrows live; card count badges update; 'Enterprise' tab shows a fixed Coming Soon state

features.name: Design system full preview (tokens/kit)
features.user_action: Click a catalog card to open the preview pane/modal
features.expected_result: Right-hand pane (or modal) renders DESIGN.md-derived component kit, color/type/spacing tokens, and package file list

features.name: Select/apply a design system (set default or switch project)
features.user_action: Click 'Make default' on a catalog row, or use the in-chat DesignSystemSwitchPicker for the active project
features.expected_result: Project's or the global default designSystemId updates; no files are copied, only the id reference changes

features.name: Import a design system (local upload / GitHub repo / shadcn registry)
features.user_action: Use the import controls in DesignSystemsSection or DesignSystemFlow to drop a local folder, paste a GitHub repo URL, or point at a shadcn registry
features.expected_result: POST /api/design-systems/import/{local,github,shadcn} creates a new 'user:' draft under 'Mine'; GitHub import gated behind requireLocalOrigin; shadcn import enforces 100-file/256KB-per-file caps

features.name: Publish / unpublish / delete a design system draft
features.user_action: Use the row action menu on a 'Mine' entry
features.expected_result: status flips draft<->published (or the entry is removed after a confirm dialog); busy spinner + toast reflect the async PATCH/DELETE

features.name: Design Templates gallery (decks/prototypes/image/video/audio)
features.user_action: Open the Templates tab in EntryView/EntryShell and browse cards
features.expected_result: Each of 353 template folders renders as a live example.html preview tile (deck templates are keyboard/wheel/touch navigable); clicking opens or seeds a new project from that template

features.name: Reference Board (curated external design-inspiration sites)
features.user_action: Open the in-app Browser's start page, pick a category chip or search, click a site card
features.expected_result: filterReferenceGroups narrows the wall by category+query across label/host/detail; clicking navigates the embedded Browser to that URL and tracks a click event

features.name: Browser Use agent-action catalog
features.user_action: Inside the embedded Browser, open the action menu and search/pick an action (extract_colors, extract_svgs, screenshot_full, audit_accessibility, etc.)
features.expected_result: filterBrowserUseCategories narrows ~35 actions across 7 categories; picking one sends the action's canned prompt to the agent bound to that browser tab

features.name: Connector tool preview
features.user_action: Open a connector's detail view
features.expected_result: Lazily fetches and lists up to 50 of that connector's available tools (CONNECTOR_TOOL_PREVIEW_LIMIT), with per-connector cached loading/failed states

features.name: Brand Reference picker (start a brand extraction)
features.user_action: Open 'Start from a brand', browse quick-picks or the full categorized/searchable wall, click a brand tile
features.expected_result: onPick fires with the brand's domain; host kicks off site extraction (or, in the Design System create flow, adds the domain as a source URL); no assets stored ahead of time, only the public favicon renders

features.name: Library/Assets registry (personal multi-source asset catalog)
features.user_action: Open the Library tab, filter by kind in the left rail, scroll the day-grouped grid, click a card for full preview
features.expected_result: Grid shows every asset that entered the system (clipper capture, upload, agent output, AI generation) with source+kind badges; live updates stream in over /api/library/events SSE; clicking opens LibraryPreviewModal

features.name: Multi-select and bulk-delete library assets
features.user_action: Checkbox-select, Cmd/Ctrl+click, Shift+click range, rubber-band drag, or Cmd/Ctrl+A across cards, then use the action bar or Delete key
features.expected_result: Selected cards highlight; bulk delete removes them via deleteLibraryAsset and updates the grid

features.name: Insert-from-library picker (composer/design-files attach)
features.user_action: '+' → Select from library (in composer or Design Files); filter by kind, multi-select assets, confirm
features.expected_result: Each picked asset copies into the active project's design files via POST /api/library/assets/:id/apply, staged as an attachment chip and recording a provenance back-link; element-pick captures inject outerHTML into the draft as a fenced code block

features.name: Plugins Home discovery grid (installed + community)
features.user_action: On Home, click an artifact-kind chip (Prototype/Slides/Image/Video/HyperFrames/Audio), optionally a scene-bucket subcategory, search, or the Saved chip
features.expected_result: usePluginFacets filters InstalledPluginRecord[] by category/subcategory/query; PluginCard renders a kind-aware hero preview (image/video poster, sandboxed HTML iframe, or design-system patch) lazily

features.name: Use / duplicate a plugin
features.user_action: Click 'Use' (or 'Use with query') / 'Duplicate' on a plugin card
features.expected_result: Plugin becomes the active driver for the next agent run, seeding the composer with its rendered use-case query; duplicate spins up a copy of its example artifact

features.name: Plugin detail modal (per-type)
features.user_action: Click 'Details' on a plugin card
features.expected_result: Modal renders type-specific content — design-system patch diff, static example, media preview, or scenario steps — plus tags, description, and primary actions

features.name: Available Plugins / marketplace browse + install
features.user_action: Open Plugins manager, search/filter by source in the Available panel, click Install
features.expected_result: filterAvailablePlugins narrows across all added marketplace manifests; Install POSTs /api/plugins/install and the card flips to a 'Use' state with a TrustBadge (restricted/trusted/official)

features.name: Plugin marketplace Sources management
features.user_action: Paste a marketplace.json URL, pick a trust level, Add; or Refresh/Remove/change trust on an existing source
features.expected_result: Marketplace list updates; each row shows plugin count, catalog version, and trust badge; refresh re-fetches that manifest

features.name: Plugin import (GitHub / zip / folder)
features.user_action: Open Import in Plugins manager, choose GitHub URL, upload a .zip, or pick a local folder
features.expected_result: Plugin installs from the chosen source via /api/plugins/install, /api/plugins/upload-zip, or /api/plugins/upload-folder

features.name: Community gallery (installed community plugins, minimal preview)
features.user_action: Browse the Community section on Home (gallery card layout)
features.expected_result: Same PluginsHomeSection component renders a top-bar-only tile per plugin (dot + name + fullscreen), using the plugin's baked example.html as the live preview

features.name: Share project to community catalog (publish direction)
features.user_action: From a finished project, click 'Share to community' / run the od-share-to-community scenario
features.expected_result: Agent packages the project into generated-plugin/, validates+packs+installs it locally, then the Design Files plugin-folder card exposes 'Add to My plugins', 'Publish repo', and 'MishMash PR' buttons to push it upstream

features.name: Stock media — no native picker (documented gap, not a bug)
features.user_action: User looks for a built-in Unsplash/Pexels-style stock photo browser
features.expected_result: None exists; the only paths are two static links (Unsplash, Pexels) inside the Reference Board that open the external site in the embedded Browser, or an agent 'asset-search' toolbox action that routes to an image-search skill rather than a UI catalog
features.not_applicable: Documented absence, not a capability. No native stock-media picker exists; DesignBrowserPanel ships two static outbound links. There is no code path to test - the absence IS the specified behaviour. Verified: grep for unsplash|pexels in DesignBrowserPanel.tsx returns exactly 2 static REFERENCE_GROUPS entries.

features.name: Chat composer file picker (native multi-select)
features.user_action: Click '+' → Attach files, or the paperclip; browser file dialog opens with no accept filter, multiple=true
features.expected_result: Selected files upload via POST /api/projects/:id/upload (12/batch, 200MB/file cap, no MIME check), land flat in the project folder, and appear as staged ChatAttachment chips

features.name: Drag-and-drop onto the composer/canvas
features.user_action: Drag one or more files from the OS Finder/Explorer and drop them anywhere on the chat composer shell
features.expected_result: Same uploadFiles() path as the file picker; dropped files stage as attachment chips identically

features.name: Paste-from-clipboard (files and screenshots)
features.user_action: Cmd/Ctrl+V into the composer with an image or file on the clipboard
features.expected_result: Synchronous clipboard files upload immediately; when the browser only exposes a screenshot via the async Clipboard API, it is read, named clipboard-screenshot-<timestamp>.<ext>, and uploaded the same way

features.name: Connector-sourced context (@-mention a connected service)
features.user_action: '+' → Connectors submenu, or type @<connector-name> in the composer, and pick a connected integration
features.expected_result: No bytes transferred through the composer — insertConnectorMention() stages the connector in RunContextSelection.connectorIds and inserts an @-mention token; the agent accesses the connector's data at run time via its wired MCP server tools

features.name: Reference project / Link local code (workspace context, not upload)
features.user_action: '+' → Reference project (pick another MishMash project) or Link local code (native folder picker)
features.expected_result: PATCHes the project's metadata.linkedDirs so the agent gets --add-dir read access to that folder; nothing is copied into the current project or staged as a ChatAttachment

features.name: OD Library manual upload (global asset library, project-independent)
features.user_action: Open the Library panel → Upload → drag/drop, paste, or browse files
features.expected_result: Strict MIME+extension allowlist (images, fonts, text, HTML, JSON/XML — audio/video explicitly rejected), ~3MB/file cap (base64-inflated JSON body limit); daemon re-validates the same policy so a rejected file shows a per-row reason; duplicate content deduped and flagged 'Already in Library'

features.name: Design-system creation: asset dropzone
features.user_action: During 'Create design system' flow, drag/drop/browse/paste logo, font, image, PDF, video, or slide-deck files
features.expected_result: Files staged client-side (kind inferred from MIME then extension) with type-aware thumbnails/lightbox; uploaded through the generic project-upload path when the design system is created

features.name: Design-system Kit: replace logo/font/image module
features.user_action: In an existing design system's Kit view, click an empty logo/font/image module and pick a replacement file
features.expected_result: uploadProjectFile() PUTs the file into logos/ | fonts/ | imagery/, then rewrites brand.json to point at the server-returned stored path; a failed upload or brand.json write surfaces onError() instead of silently no-op'ing

features.name: Import project from local folder
features.user_action: Choose 'Import folder' (native OS folder picker via the host bridge, or a web fallback)
features.expected_result: Creates a new project whose metadata.baseDir points at the selected folder (files stay in place, not copied); import failures (cancel vs. real error) are distinguished

features.name: Skill package import
features.user_action: Import a skill (zip/package) via the Skills settings surface
features.expected_result: POST /api/skills/import ingests and installs a skill package into the local skills store

features.name: Storyboard uploads
features.user_action: Upload media/assets within the Storyboard feature
features.expected_result: POST /api/storyboards/:id/uploads handles storyboard-scoped uploads on a separate route module from the project-attachment pipeline

features.name: API-mode attachment context injection
features.user_action: N/A — automatic when a BYOK/API-mode run includes staged attachments
features.expected_result: historyWithApiAttachmentContext() renders each attachment as a fenced code/text block (raw text for html/text/code/svg/sketch.json, section previews for pdf/document/presentation/spreadsheet) appended to the user's message, truncated at 24,000 chars/attachment and 64,000 chars total, with images optionally omitted when the provider supports native image attachments
